xai/grok-imagine-image.name: Grok Imagine Image
xai/grok-imagine-image.notes: Fast and cheap. Good aesthetic quality. No seed control yet.

sync_mode.note: true = returns data URI inline, not stored in history

tips: Use 1k for iteration, 2k only for finals (same cost).
Use fal.subscribe() not fal.run() — subscribe polls until done.
No seed parameter: can't reproduce exact outputs.
aspect_ratio affects composition significantly — pick before prompting.
dont: Don't use sync_mode:true for batch — outputs aren't stored in fal history.
Don't expect exact reproduction — no seed control.

fal-ai/flux/schnell.name: FLUX Schnell
fal-ai/flux/schnell.notes: Cheapest quality image gen. Use for rapid iteration.
tips: 4 steps is the sweet spot — more steps don't help much on Schnell.
Use for A/B prompt testing before spending on quality models.
dont: Don't use for final outputs — step up to flux-pro for finals.

fal-ai/sam2/auto-segment.name: SAM 2 Auto-Segment
fal-ai/sam2/auto-segment.notes: Segments every distinct region automatically. No prompt needed.
tips: Returns individual_masks array — one URL per detected object.
Use dest-in blend with sharp to apply mask as alpha channel.
Combine with sharp to produce transparent PNGs per object.

xai/grok-imagine-video/image-to-video.name: Grok Imagine Video (img2vid)
xai/grok-imagine-video/image-to-video.notes: Animate a still image into video. Async — use submit_job.
tips: Always use fal.queue.submit() — video is slow.
